title: Effective and efficient photoluminescence of salicylate-ligating terbium(III) clusters stabilized by multiple phenyl–phenyl interactions

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: nonanuclear terbium(III) hexyl salicylate hydroxo cluster

material_class.structural_family: nonanuclear lanthanide hydroxo cluster with two square-pyramidal Tb4 units about a central Tb

synthesis.procedure: TNS-He was prepared analogously to TNS-Me: hexyl salicylate was dissolved in methanol, triethylamine was added with stirring at 40 °C, then Tb(NO3)3·6H2O in methanol was added dropwise and the mixture was stirred for 20 min. A single crystal of TNS-He was obtained by slow evaporation of the reaction mixture in methanol.

reagents.name: hexyl salicylate
reagents.amount: used in place of methyl salicylate (0.600 g, 3.94 mmol in the TNS-Me procedure)

synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred solution; slow evaporation of the methanol reaction mixture for crystals
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: single crystals by slow evaporation of the reaction mixture in methanol

properties.summary: TNS-He shows a ~25 nm bathochromic shift of the ligand π–π* absorption versus TNS-Me, attributed to J-type π–π stacking, with high molar absorptivity into the near-UV/violet. Excitation at 380 nm gives Tb(III) 4f–4f emission, strongest at 545 nm (5D4→7F5); the 5D4→7F5 intensity is seven times that of TNS-Me in methanol, and the relative emission efficiency TNS-He/TNS-Me is 3.0 after normalization by ε. Solid-state luminescence is also stronger than for TNS-Me.

measurements.name: absorption red-shift vs TNS-Me
measurements.conditions: methanol; TNS-Me π–π* carbonyl peak ~315 nm not observed for TNS-He

measurements.name: relative emission efficiency TNS-He/TNS-Me
measurements.conditions: peak integral of emission intensity normalized by ε values

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: nonanuclear terbium(III) methyl salicylate hydroxo cluster

material_class.structural_family: nonanuclear lanthanide hydroxo cluster (analogous to TNS-He)

synthesis.procedure: Methyl salicylate (0.600 g, 3.94 mmol) was dissolved in methanol and triethylamine (0.648 g, 6.41 mmol) was added with stirring at 40 °C. Tb(NO3)3·6H2O (1.00 g, 2.22 mmol) in methanol was then added dropwise and the mixture was stirred for a further 20 min, affording TNS-Me as a white powder.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: white powder isolated (no crystal structure reported)

properties.summary: TNS-Me in methanol shows a ligand π–π* absorption near 315 nm and Tb(III) 4f–4f emission under 380 nm excitation with the strongest band at 545 nm (5D4→7F5). Its emission intensity and relative efficiency are lower than those of TNS-He.
